c1: Hey everyone! I've been thinking about making a brand new animated series.
c2: Check out this trailer. If you like it, tell me in the comments. And if you want any changes, let me know that too!
n1: In the cold lands of the north, a quiet farm stands at the edge of the world.
n2: Eirik Stonehand. A farmhand who swore he would never fight again.
n3: Sigrun Frostveil. A wandering spear maiden, searching for the home she lost.
n4: Halvard the Grey. An old smith who remembers the wars everyone else forgot.
n5: Tove. A young scout. Faster than the wind, and braver than she should be.
n6: And Jarl Ulfrik Blackmane... who wants this land, and everyone on it.
n7: When the raiders come, every promise will be tested.
n8: Warriors of the North. Coming soon.
c3: If you liked it, drop a comment below, and I'll start this series! Thanks for watching.
